en: The postcard image shows a grand square with gardens and avenues converging at a large Gothic revival church with two tall spires. The church is surrounded by early 20th-century buildings and light vehicular and pedestrian traffic, suggesting an era before modern cars dominated streets. Handwritten text is visible at the bottom, and the overall style resembles vintage postcards.
